_comment: Curated brand -> {device/format token: category}. Some products are only identifiable by a brand's hardware name — 'Select Briq V2' and 'Florist Farms Rechargeable OVL' are vapes with no generic vape word anywhere in the name, so the model has to guess and guesses concentrate. A token here is matched on word boundaries in the product name and settles the category outright, before the model is asked. That is brand trivia, not reasoning: it does not belong in a prompt (paid for on every call, never scales past a handful of brands) but it costs nothing here and applies identically across every dispensary. Keys starting with _ are ignored; the key "*" applies to every brand. Category must be one of CATEGORIES in scripts/enrich.py. Grow from the `unmapped_category_bucket` / `category_token_conflict` findings of evals/enrich/audit.py.
_comment_star: Tokens under "*" apply to every brand, so they must be measured fleet-wide before being added. "Vaporizer" matches 104 active listings and 104 of them are vape hardware; "Exxus" matches 6, all of them. Brand-wide rules were REJECTED for Yocan and Wulf on the same measurement — both sell real accessories (batteries, knife kits, torches) alongside their vaporizers, and a blanket rule would have dragged 9 correct merch rows into vaporizers.
